extracted.intended_audience: state agencies, agency administrators, and staff preparing and submitting notices for publication in the Florida Administrative Register (FAR)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing, formatting, coding, and submitting agency notices (rule notices, meeting notices, petitions, emergency rules, etc.) for publication in the Florida Administrative Register using the e-rulemaking system and the prescribed templates, schedules, and content requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication schedule and submission deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: The FAR is published each business day except official state holidays; when a business day is observed as a holiday, publication shall be on the next business day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All notices to be published in the FAR must be received by the Administrative Code and Register Section by 3:00 p.m. each business day to be published the next business day.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic submission requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All notices to be published in the FAR must be submitted electronically through the Department of State's e-rulemaking website (www.flrules.org/agency/login.asp).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies shall contact the Administrative Code and Register Section to designate one or more agency administrator(s) to manage submissions, and a billing profile shall be completed on the e-rulemaking website prior to submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: General composition requirements for rule notices
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules about what may be in a single rule notice and prohibited content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A single rule notice may contain more than one rule if the rules share the same chapter number. Rule notices shall not contain any markup revision, redlining or automatic numbering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coding of new and amended rule text
rubrics_metrics.description: How to code new rules and amendments within rule notices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A new rule shall be coded by underlining all text, including spaces and punctuation. An amended rule shall be coded by underlining new text and striking through deleted text; new text shall appear before deleted text. The space immediately before and after new or deleted text shall not be coded. Newly inserted subsections/paragraphs/etc. shall be coded per examples. A portion of a word shall not be amended without completely striking through existing text and inserting new text unless the amendment changes capitalization (capitalization change coded by adding newly inserted letter immediately before deleted letter). Any subsection/paragraph/etc. not being amended shall not be included and shall be noted as "No change", unless inclusion is necessary to make the publication complete and meaningful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coding when amendment is substantially reworded
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure when coding would hinder understanding due to extensive amendments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an amendment is so extensive that coding would hinder understanding, the notice shall only contain the underlined new text. The rule number and the existing rule title, legal citations and history note lines shall not be underlined. Amendments to the rule title, legal citations, or history notes shall be coded to indicate new or deleted text. Insert directory line immediately before the rule number and title: "Substantial rewording of Rule __________ follows. See Florida Administrative Code for present text." The present text of the rule shall not be included in the notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rule repeals coding and summary requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: How to notice rule repeals and what must be published.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rule repeals shall be coded by underlining the word "Repealed" in the history note. The full text of the rule is not required to be published in the FAR; only a reference to the rule number, rule title, legal citations and history notes must be published, provided that the rule summary portion of the notice fully describes the subject matter of the repealed rule text. Partial rule repeals will be treated the same as an amendment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting requirements (margins, justification, font, indents)
rubrics_metrics.description: Page and text formatting for all notices submitted for publication in the FAR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Margins shall be set at 1'' at the top, bottom and sides. Text shall be left justified. The font shall be 10 point Times New Roman. Indents shall be set at 0.25''.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of required templates and selecting alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Templates containing the required format for notices are available on the e-rulemaking website and must be used; where alternatives exist, select only the applicable alternatives for publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Templates are provided for various notice types; when a template includes multiple alternatives (e.g., rule development workshop alternatives or preliminary text alternatives), only one of each alternative should be selected for publication in the FAR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Rule Development content and options
rubrics_metrics.description: Required format and selectable alternatives for a Notice of Rule Development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template fields include: NAME OF AGENCY; Division or Board; RULE NO.: RULE TITLE:; PURPOSE AND EFFECT; SUBJECT AREA TO BE ADDRESSED; RULEMAKING AUTHORITY; LAW IMPLEMENTED. For workshops, choose and publish only one of the provided workshop alternatives. Provide preliminary text alternatives: indicate whether preliminary text is available, not available, or available at no charge from contact person; if text is included it must be coded per subsection (3).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Proposed Rule timing and required elements
rubrics_metrics.description: A Notice of Proposed Rule must be published in the FAR before filing any rule for adoption (except specified exceptions) and must follow prescribed format and content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template fields include NAME OF AGENCY; Division or Board; RULE NO.: RULE TITLE:; PURPOSE AND EFFECT; SUMMARY; SUMMARY OF STATEMENT OF ESTIMATED REGULATORY COSTS AND LEGISLATIVE RATIFICATION (SERC info); RULEMAKING AUTHORITY; LAW IMPLEMENTED. The notice must state whether the rule will or will not have adverse impact on small business or likely increase regulatory costs in excess of $200,000 and whether a SERC has been prepared. Persons wishing to provide information regarding the SERC or propose a lower cost regulatory alternative must do so in writing within 21 days of the notice. Hearing options and timelines are specified; only one hearing alternative should be selected for publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Intent to Adopt a Rule (120.54(6)) requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Format and comment/objection timelines for Notices of Intent to Adopt a Rule pursuant to Section 120.54(6), F.S. (adoption of federal standards).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template fields include NAME OF AGENCY; Division or Board; RULE NO.: RULE TITLE:; PURPOSE, EFFECT AND SUMMARY; RULEMAKING AUTHORITY; LAW IMPLEMENTED; statement that rulemaking is undertaken pursuant to Section 120.54(6), F.S. Written comments may be submitted within 14 days of the notice to the named contact person. Substantially affected persons may within 14 days file an objection specifying portions objected to and specific reasons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Intent to Adopt a Rule (120.54(1)(i)5) requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Format required when adopting rules pursuant to Section 120.54(1)(i)5., F.S.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template same structure as other Notices of Intent to Adopt a Rule; rule text shall be coded as described in subsection (3). Substantially affected persons may within 14 days of the notice file an objection specifying portions and reasons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Intent to Adopt a Rule (403.8055) requirements and timelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific format and timelines for Notices of Intent to Adopt a Rule pursuant to Section 403.8055, F.S. (Department of Environmental Protection).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template fields include NAME OF AGENCY; Division or Board; RULE NO.: RULE TITLE:; PURPOSE, EFFECT AND SUMMARY; RULEMAKING AUTHORITY; LAW IMPLEMENTED; statement of undertaking pursuant to Section 403.8055, F.S. Written comments may be submitted within 21 days of the notice to the named contact person. Substantially affected persons may within 14 days of the notice file an objection to the rulemaking with the Environmental Regulation Commission; objections must specify the portions objected to and specific reasons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Change content and coding
rubrics_metrics.description: When changes are made to proposed rule text pursuant to Section 120.54(3)(d)1., a Notice of Change must be filed and formatted as prescribed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rule text published in the Notice of Proposed Rule shall be used as the basis for coding the additional rule changes included in the Notice of Change. Coding of rule text in the Notice of Change shall be as described in subsection (3) of this rule. Template must include agency name, division, rule number and title, and a statement referencing the prior Vol./No./date of the Notice of Proposed Rule and then the text of proposed rule changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Withdrawal format
rubrics_metrics.description: Format to be used when withdrawing proposed rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template fields include NAME OF AGENCY; Division or Board; RULE NO.: RULE TITLE:; NOTICE OF WITHDRAWAL; and a statement noting that the rule as noticed in Vol.____, No._____, (date), Florida Administrative Register has been withdrawn.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Emergency Rule requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Format and timing for Notices of Emergency Rule to be published in the first available issue of the FAR following filing the emergency rule for adoption.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emergency rules shall be coded as specified in subsection (3). Template fields include NAME OF AGENCY; Division or Board; RULE NO.: RULE TITLE:; SPECIFIC REASONS FOR FINDING AN IMMEDIATE DANGER TO THE PUBLIC, HEALTH, SAFETY OR WELFARE; REASONS FOR CONCLUDING THAT THE PROCEDURE USED IS FAIR UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES; SUMMARY OF THE RULE; THE PERSON TO BE CONTACTED REGARDING THE EMERGENCY RULE IS; THE FULL TEXT OF THE EMERGENCY RULE IS (TEXT OF RULE); EFFECTIVE DATE. The rule takes effect upon filing with the Department of State unless a later time/date specified in the rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Variance or Waiver template and comment period
rubrics_metrics.description: Format to be used to notice a petition for variance or waiver and the opportunity for public comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template fields include NAME OF AGENCY; NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that on (date), the (name of agency) received a petition for a variance or waiver; Petitioner's Name; Rule No.; Nature of the rule for which variance or waiver is sought; A copy of the Petition for variance or waiver may be obtained by contacting: Any interested person or other agency may submit written comments within 14 days after the publication of this notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Disposition of Variance or Waiver content
rubrics_metrics.description: Format for publishing disposition (agency order) on petitions for variance or waiver.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template fields include NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that on (date), the (name of agency) has issued an order; Petitioner's Name; Date Petition Filed; Rule No.; Nature of the rule for which variance or waiver is sought; Date Petition Published in the Florida Administrative Register; General Basis for Agency Decision; A copy of the Order may be obtained by contacting:

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice format for public meetings, hearings, or workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Required format and minimum content for notices of public meetings, hearings, or workshops.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template fields include: The (name of agency) announces a (public meeting, hearing or workshop) to which all persons are invited: DATE AND TIME; PLACE; GENERAL SUBJECT MATTER TO BE CONSIDERED; A copy of the agenda may be obtained by contacting:.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Petition for Declaratory Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Format for notices that an agency has received a petition for a declaratory statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template fields include NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN THAT (name of agency) ______, has received a petition for a declaratory statement from (name of petitioner). The petition seeks the agency's opinion as to the applicability of (statute, rule or order number) as it applies to the petitioner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Disposition of Declaratory Statement content
rubrics_metrics.description: Format for publishing the agency's disposition of petitions for declaratory statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template fields include NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN THAT (name of agency) has issued an order disposing of the petition for declaratory statement filed by (petitioner's name) on (date of petition). Include a summary of the agency's disposition: state that the petition was denied and reasons for denial or that the petition was granted and set out a summary of the substance of the response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of invalidation of a proposed or effective rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Format to be used when an administrative law judge or court has determined that a rule is invalid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template fields include NOTICE OF THE INVALIDATION OF A PROPOSED OR EFFECTIVE RULE and a statement that an ALJ or court has determined that (rule no.) is invalid; the time for filing an appeal of this decision expired (date). Optionally insert a summary of the hearing officer's determination. If the rule declared invalid is a proposed rule, the rule number inserted in the notice shall be prefixed by the word "proposed."

rubrics_metrics.name: Department enforcement: rejection of noncomplying notices
rubrics_metrics.description: The department will reject notices that do not comply with the rule's requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any notice that does not comply with the requirements specified in this rule shall be rejected by the department.
